Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge
 Order

By this appeal filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, appellant herein has challenged order dated 22.09.2025, passed by the Presiding Officer, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Leh in case titled "Tashi Tundup & Anr. V. United India Insurance Co. Ltd.", whereby an award to the tune of Rs.17,23,800/- along with interest @ 9% per annum has been passed in favour of respondent Nos.1 & 2/claimants.

entities.text: Tashi Tundup & Anr. V. United India Insurance Co. Ltd.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 02. Learned counsel for the appellant herein has challenged the quantum of the compensation awarded as well as liability of the Insurance Company to indemnify the owner.

03. Issue notice to the respondents, subject to taking of requisite steps for service within two weeks.
04.

05. Meanwhile, subject to deposit of the entire awarded amount along with interest accrued thereon,
by the appellant before the Registry of this Court, within a period of four weeks, execution of the impugned award dated 22.09.2025, shall remain stayed.
The amount, on its receipt, shall be kept in FDR initially for a period of six months, to be renewed periodically.
